Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3389); Hierosolyma (i.e. Jerushalaim), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare G2419.
BiblicalUsage: Jerusalem is the capital city of Palestine, named 63 times in Scripture, in Matthew, Mark, and Luke. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jerusalem matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Jerusalem is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
RelatedEvents: The Magi Visit Jesus; The Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
